notes.title: Yarn Guardians — Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Today we fly. Five fearless, flying cats, yarn-powered abilities, and a hand-drawn world await you — available now on Steam.[/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you to:
• The community — for wishlists, playtests, feedback, and endless encouragement.
• Creators — for streams, videos, and sharing cozy chaos with your audiences.
• The devs at Pentapaw Studios — for the craft, care, and magic that made this world real.[/p][p]We hope you have a great time playing — and we’re excited to read your honest reviews![/p]

notes.title: Release Update: Yarn Guardians Launch Moved to August 14, 2025
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, We have a small update: [i]Yarn Guardians[/i] will now launch on [b]August 14[/b].[/p][p]The reason? We're still finishing up localization, and we want [b]everyone around the world[/b] to have the [b]same great experience[/b] on day one – no matter which language they play in.[/p][p]The game is nearly done (and we're really proud of it!), but a few final touches are still in the works.[/p][p]The [b]demo is still live on Steam[/b], so feel free to jump in while you wait![/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and support – it means the world to us. – The Yarn Guardians Team [/p]
